_readme: REFERENCE THEME. dark.json declares the complete key set and is the
default: css/theme.css is generated from it by .github/scripts/sync-theme.js,
so a page on the default fetches no theme file. theme.css's :root block
must never be hand-edited.
Themes are never partial: every other theme declares every key this file
declares, because the loader writes a theme over theme.css and a missing
key would show this file's value. sync-theme.js refuses a shipped theme
that is incomplete; a key added here is added to every theme in the same
change.
colors.<group>.<key> -> --color-<prefix>-<kebab-key>. Group prefixes are fixed
in the loader's mapping table; do not rename a group without updating both the
loader and sync-theme.js.
tokens.<name> -> --<name>, emitted verbatim with NO prefix. Structure and
sizing live in css/base.css; this block exists so an accessibility or custom
theme can override a specific structural token (shadows, radii, focus ring)
without a second mechanism, and only a token base.css declares. The reference
theme leaves it empty on purpose - populating it here would duplicate
base.css and drift.
Colours are opaque by policy: the palette is composited, and overlapping
transparency is unmanageable. Values are 6-digit hex; the loader reports
anything else and sync-theme.js refuses it. semantic.scrim/scrimStrong are
the sanctioned exception - a modal backdrop must be see-through - and use
rgb()/hsl() functional forms.
description: Default dark theme. Reference schema for all other themes.
author: Eltryus - Ricardo Marques
